{{Top|leg}}
'''Chief Aide''' was a title used by several individuals. [[Denaria Kee/Legends|Denaria Kee]] had earned the position of Chief Aide to [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]]<ref name="SWFC">{{ForceCollection|Denaria Kee|star=2}}</ref> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>. It was also a position held by [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], assistant to several [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrators]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>
